subject: Computer Science
source_note: TIE (2023), Computer Science Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of the basic principles of Computer Science

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate an understanding of the basic principles of computer architecture
competences: (a) Describe the concept of data representation (digital data, number systems, data type, character coding (UNICODE and ASCII)
(b) Represent numbers in different number systems (binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal)
(c) Convert numbers from one system to another (binary, decimal, and hexadecimal)
(d) Perform arithmetic operations (addition and subtraction) using binary numbers

objectives.text: (a) Describe the concept of data representation (digital data, number systems, data type, character coding (UNICODE and ASCII)
objectives.teaching_methods: Question-and-answer, TIPS, and small group discussion
objectives.assessment_criteria: Explicitly explain the concept of digital data representation

objectives.text: (b) Represent numbers in different number systems (binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Confidently represent numbers in different number systems

objectives.text: (c) Convert numbers from one system to another (binary, decimal, and hexadecimal)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Competently convert numbers from one system to another

objectives.text: (d) Perform arithmetic operations (addition and subtraction) using binary numbers

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate an understanding of basic principles of computer programming
competences: (a) Use the syntax and constructs of selected programming language to write program (iteration, functions, array, and string)
(b) Use scope of variable in a program
(c) Text and Debug computer program that employs iteration, array, string, branching and functions
(d) Appraise the utility of the developed program

objectives.text: (a) Use the syntax and constructs of selected programming language to write program (iteration, functions, array, and string)
objectives.resources: Computer installed with appropriate programming tools
objectives.assessment_criteria: Confidently use iteration and functions in a program

objectives.text: (b) Use scope of variable in a program
objectives.assessment_criteria: Confidently describe and use the concept of scope of variable

objectives.text: (c) Text and Debug computer program that employs iteration, array, string, branching and functions
objectives.assessment_criteria: Confidently debug computer program that employs iteration and functions branching and functions

objectives.text: (d) Appraise the utility of the developed program
objectives.assessment_criteria: Clearly evaluate the efficacy of the developed application

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate an understanding of the basics of computer networks
competences: (a) Describe the concept of computer network) (meaning, mode, media, components, etc.)
(b) Design a simple computer network involving a typical topology
(c) Create a computer network involving typical topology

objectives.text: (a) Describe the concept of computer network) (meaning, mode, media, components, etc.)
objectives.resources: Computer with installed internet, network cables and network card
objectives.assessment_criteria: Can clarify the concept computer network

objectives.text: (b) Design a simple computer network involving a typical topology
objectives.assessment_criteria: Can design a simple computer network of a given topology

objectives.text: (c) Create a computer network involving typical topology
objectives.assessment_criteria: Confidently can use topology, data transmission mode and media to set computer network

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of the basic principles of data management

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate the mastery of basic principles of databases and database management systems
competences: (a) Describe the concept of data and information
(b) Manage simple data (create, store, retrieve, check data quality)
(c) Describe the concept of database and database management system
(e) Create a database using selected software (e.g., MS – Access)

objectives.text: (a) Describe the concept of data and information
objectives.resources: Computer installed with appropriate tools for managing data
objectives.assessment_criteria: Cleary describe the concepts of data and information

objectives.text: (b) Manage simple data (create, store, retrieve, check data quality)
(c) Describe the concept of database and database management system
objectives.assessment_criteria: Explicitly elaborate the concept of database and database management system

objectives.resources: Computer installed with appropriate tools for database design
objectives.assessment_criteria: Clearly explain the concept of database

objectives.text: (e) Create a database using selected software (e.g., MS – Access)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Clearly identify steps of designing and developing a database and step by step create a database
